name: gitlab-runner-pool-large
description: GitLab CI jobs in one virtual machine (Debian 13; 32 CPUs, 64GiB, 300GiB): GitLab Runner 19.5.3 by digest, docker executor, up to 12 runners of one GitLab. A job runs in fresh, unprivileged containers on one Docker daemon: the machine is the boundary, not the container, so keep a signing or attested runner in a pool of its own or outside. More capacity is a second pool with the same tokens. Created stopped: give url and runners in settings, set GITLAB_RUNNER_TOKEN_<n>, then instance_start.

settingRules.why: the pool runs one job at a time or more
the pool reads a count of jobs of at most three digits
a job has one CPU or more
the pool reads a count of CPUs of at most three digits
at 100 the jobs' memory caps add up to no more than the machine has for jobs, and that is the least
at 200 the jobs' memory caps add up to twice what the machine has for jobs, and that is the most
the pool needs one entry for each runner you created in GitLab
one pool takes at most 12 runners, each with a secret of its own: create a second pool for the others
